slides.h: What if your skincare could do more?
body: A professional spicule treatment, now at Third Space.
Glassifier uses microscopic marine spicules to help selected skincare ingredients reach the skin, rather than sitting on the surface.

slides.h: Your skin’s barrier is clever. Here’s how to work with it.
body: Its outer layer keeps things out, which is its job. The spicules create temporary pathways so selected ingredients, including GHK peptides, can get through.

slides.h: The question isn’t what you put on your skin. It’s what reaches it.
body: That’s the thinking behind Glassifier. It isn’t right for every skin, and redness and light flaking afterwards are common, so it always starts with advice.

slides.h: Curious about spicules? So were we.
body: We did our homework before bringing Glassifier to the clinic, and we’ll talk you through it honestly.
slides.extra: Curious whether Glassifier is right for your skin? Let’s have a conversation.
